title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
desc: After an accident, Ruhaan decides to help Reet, which leads him to her family's ancestral mansion, which is haunted by a vengeful spirit.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3
desc: Ruhaan, a fake ghost-chaser, takes a job at a spooky castle and finds out about a bad plan by tricky priests. His trip becomes a funny but scary ride with lots of surprises and frights.

title: Robinhood
desc: A modern-day Robin Hood thrives on stealing from the rich. However, he reluctantly becomes a bodyguard for a high-profile client due to unforeseen circumstances.

title: Sisu
desc: A Finnish ex-soldier-turned-prospector discovers gold in the Lapland and decides to take it into town. But when a platoon of Nazi soldiers steal his gold, he is forced to wipe them out on his own.

title: Mahavatar Narsimha
desc: Hiranyakashyap, a demon, challenges Vishnu, proclaiming himself a god. However, his son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu, who appears as Narsimha to defeat the demon.

title: Mardaani 3
desc: When girls vanish mysteriously, Shivani Shivaji Roy tracks down a merciless crime syndicate accountable for abducting over 90 girls nationwide.

title: MLA Ka Power
desc: A simple man falls for a rich landlord's daughter and in order to prove his love and marry her, he must become an MLA and succeed.
